newsitem.title: CHINA: China to build Yangtze mineral fertiliser wharf.
newsitem.headline: China to build Yangtze mineral fertiliser wharf.

text.p: China will invest 110 million yuan in building a large mineral fertiliser wharf in the middle reaches of the Yangtze river in the next five years, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.
In Zhicheng city in central Hubei province, the transit wharf is designed to have an annual handling capacity of 1.6 million tonnes when it is completed before the end of this century, Xinhua said.
In the first phase of construction, 65 million yuan will be spent building a berth for general cargo, with a yearly handling capacity of 400,000 tonnes, it said.
The wharf will boost shipments of products from the Wengfu mineral fertiliser production base in southwestern Guizhou province.
Zhicheng alrady has a port with a handling capacity of 3.3 million tonnes, it said.
